description: The Villager #'s aren't perfect as it can vary based on map/opponent civ/how quickly you can macro - more of just an outline that you can play around with!
name: I love China Sm (Pro Scout)
author: Yony

notes: 5@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ to collect 50@resource/resource_wood.webp@, then to @resource/sheep.webp@, 1@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to build @building_economy/mill.webp@ behind TC and next to wood line

Once 5@resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ collect 50 wood, 1@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to build @building_chinese/village.webp@ next to @building_economy/mill.webp@, then that @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@

4 age up@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ will go on @resource/resource_wood.webp@,  @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 12 - @resource/rally.webp@ to the first tree you chopped down for quick gathering
Gather the @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ until second @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ pops out

Immediately queue @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ until you have 4/4, first will supervise @building_economy/mill.webp@ (collect & drop off 40 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ with first @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ before supervising).

When second @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ pops out, pull all @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to make a @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ & have @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ supervise while building - any @resource/resource_wood.webp@ the @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ are carrying will be boosted once @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ is completed
Third @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ can just be left to roam and collect @resource/resource_gold.webp@ from buildings
Build a @building_military/stable.webp@ ASAP to produce @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ for @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@

As you approach the 300@resource/resource_gold.webp@ needed for @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@, pull all @resource/resource_gold.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ onto @resource/resource_wood.webp@, then @resource/rally.webp@@resource/sheep.webp@
Fourth @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ will supervise @building_military/stable.webp@ for fast @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ production (make 4-6)

Once @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ is researched, next upgrade will be @technology_chinese/imperial-examination.webp@ (Very easy to forget as it's inside the landmark but very important!!!)

Transcribed from Corvinus1's build order on Youtube, all thanks to him!

name: 1TC Feudal Aggression
author: Jitterbug

notes: At this point, you should be trying to find damage on pocket resources.  You can use the @landmark_chinese/barbican-of-the-sun.webp@ aggressively around or within the opponent's base (get @technology_economy/textiles.webp@ first if doing this)
Now you have to decide to ram push (build under cover of @landmark_chinese/barbican-of-the-sun.webp@) or to prepare to go @age/age_3.webp@ w/ @landmark_chinese/astronomical-clocktower.webp@

name: NEW Best 4 IO Chinese By DranZerJJ
author: DranZerJJ

notes: two @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@  @abilities/repair.webp@ @landmark_chinese/imperial-academy.webp@ close to the @building_economy/mill.webp@ and the @resource/resource_wood.webp@
the 5 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ go @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ in the area of @landmark_chinese/imperial-academy.webp@
the @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ collect @ability_chinese/collect_tax.webp@ taxe of @building_economy/mill.webp@ and then boost it
the Second @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@  @ability_chinese/collect_tax.webp@ of the @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ and @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ each
@building_economy/mill.webp@ close to base, near wood if possible (for IP to be close to both @building_economy/mill.webp@&@building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@)
Rally two @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ first builds @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ second builds @building_economy/house.webp@
Rally to food until you can afford @landmark_chinese/imperial-academy.webp@

Build @landmark_chinese/imperial-academy.webp@ with 3 @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@     -     pull two @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@     -     Rally next @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@
supervise @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ or whichever eco building has most @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@
build @building_chinese/village.webp@ can be any villager, depends on where best placement for village is
supervise @building_economy/mill.webp@ with second @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@  remember to micro for more gold. If low APM get 3rd @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@
Get to 5 @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ including the free one. One is for scouting unless not needed

Make @building_military/archery-range.webp@ &  @building_military/barracks.webp@ and produce @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@@unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ or spam @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@@unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ if facing cavalry and archers
Decide whether to fight and stay Feudal or go Castle
when 2nd @unit_chinese/imperial-official.webp@ move @unit_worker/villager-china.webp@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ on @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ and supervise it
either pressure with @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@ or start making 4 @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@
put some pressure with either @building_military/archery-range.webp@ or @building_military/barracks.webp@
@building_military/archery-range.webp@ Hacer un poco de presión si se puede
